findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - resume a sign-off previously stopped after round 2 with only below-bar findings.
The previous code persisted `stop: true` for this case in `.factory/client-signoff.json`. On retry, `src/forge/records.py:488–491` immediately asks the owner whenever that saved flag is true, before reaching the corrected condition here. Consequently, clients already affected by this bug still need an owner decision despite having no blocking findings. Revalidate persisted stops against the saved review's blocking findings before honoring them, and cover this resume path through the decision command.
